governingStandard: HOEOS v2 Article 4 & G2/G5 UI Display Fidelity

checks.name: Unique Matched Coverage Display Binding
checks.expectedBinding: Directly displays authoritative uniqueMatchedCoverage formatted to 1 decimal place
checks.notes: No UI fallback transforms, rounds up, or alters authoritative percentage.

checks.name: Highest Source Match Display Binding
checks.expectedBinding: Directly displays authoritative highestSourceMatch formatted to 1 decimal place
checks.notes: Clearly segregated in dual-metric grid from overall document overlap.

checks.name: Objective Similarity Classification Tiers
checks.expectedBinding: Labels score intervals objectively (VERY HIGH, HIGH, MODERATE, LOW, VERY LOW) without declaring misconduct
checks.notes: Complies with G2/G5 governance: similarity score is an objective lexical overlap metric.

checks.name: Hierarchical Source Breakdown Tracing
checks.expectedBinding: Iterates real sentenceEvidence items displaying verbatim studentText, similarityPercentage, and matchType
checks.observedOutput: Iterates through sourceReports[].sentenceEvidence displaying authentic documentUnitId and similarity percentages
checks.notes: User interface faithfully visualizes exact sentences flagged by the deterministic engine.

checks.name: Empty Document Input Rejection
checks.expectedBinding: Rejects empty text with "Please select or enter document text to verify." and displays error banner

observedOutput.uiPrompt: Please select or enter document text to verify.

checks.notes: Fails closed gracefully; zero division or uncaught exception avoided.
